hero.name: Antonio Batarilović.
hero.tagline: I build things for the web.
hero.intro: Third-year student at FER in Zagreb, currently attending the Sofascore Frontend Academy. I tend to end up on the frontend, but I'm just as interested in backend and interface design. What I enjoy most is the whole process of building an app, from idea to deploy.
